# 2.4.6 Headings and Labels (Level AA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.4 Navigable
- Level: AA
- Versions: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/headings-and-labels.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#headings-and-labels

## Normative text

Headings and [labels](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-labels) describe topic or purpose.

## Sufficient techniques

Headings and labels must be programmatically determined, per Success Criterion 1.3.1.

- G130: Providing descriptive headings
- G131: Providing descriptive labels
